quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's unique offensive versatility and impact on team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: There is no one that can stop Jalen Brunson one-on-one. It is not a coverage, it is not a defender.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: There is no one that can stop Jalen Brunson one-on-one. It is not a coverage, it is not a defender. That is who he is.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Did you see the first player of the game? We know he got up to the top of the key for a wide-open three, but I actually got the film today.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Lowe
text_blocks.text: Watch this Mike Brown play. Here go one screen right here on Wembanyama. Here go another screen, a back screen right here for OG Anunoby to cause so much distraction, and all of a sudden he pops back.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: And you know what happens. Jalen Brunson, tray ball, right in their face to start the game of the NBA Finals. Again, it is a reason I nicknamed this man Big Body Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's physical playstyle and rise to stardom
quotes.excerpt: It is because he embraces physicality. It is because all his life, he has been a small guard walking into arenas.
quotes.quote: It is because he embraces physicality. It is because all his life, he has been a small guard walking into arenas. Since high school, since going to camps, since he won championships at Villanova, to now when he got in the league. We knew that he was not supposed to be drafted in the second round, but he proved us wrong. Ever since he has been in the Nick uniform, he has been a top-10 player in this league.
